items.title: In 2022, 3-year-old Ryker Webb went missing from his family's yard in Troy, Montana. Two days later he was found about 2.5 miles away, and the internet lost it. People said he came back in different clothes and didn't even look like the same kid, and the skinwalker theories took off from there. So we went to Troy to find out for ourselves. We walked the trail, stayed out in the woods overnight, and asked the locals, but almost nobody in that town wanted to talk to us. We ended up talking to someone from his family, and he cleared up a lot. The neighbors called the police because the family was out searching for him themselves, and the CPS stuff cleared up fast. Whatever really happened, Ryker is around 7 now and just trying to be a normal kid. Don't harass him or his family. Some mysteries should stay unsolved. Full video is on my channel. #punchmadedev #rykerwebb
